description: Checks a flow with the same engine the Strategy Builder uses. Returns errors (must fix) and warnings (review). Error codes: E201 loop, E202 no Start, E203 unreachable node, E204 unconnected input, E205 indicator wired straight into an order, E206 duplicate single-use node.

flows.description: Usually one flow. Several flows = a portfolio EA, one Start node each.

data.description: Parameter values keyed by property key

id.description: Unique within the flow, e.g. n1

settings.description: Shared EA settings (same shape as get_template settings); omit for defaults

name: validate_flow
title: Validate a flow
